A LITTLE CLARITY

Before you enquire.

How do I check if a part fits my machine?

Share the exact machine model and the part or cartridge code. Parts are model-specific; the product categories shown here do not guarantee compatibility.

Where can I see prices and stock?

Current inventory and prices have not been provided for this catalogue. Request a quote to confirm the model, price, availability and delivery options.

Is my service appointment confirmed online?

No. The form prepares a service request with your preferred date. Submit the form to email your request, then confirm the appointment and charges with the team.

Are these photos of the actual products?

The images are representative illustrations. Ask for a photo and the exact specification of the item being quoted before purchasing.
